From: Molly Jensen <molly.jensen@atlasbank.com>

Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ: Tenant isolation evidence & runtime segmentation

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our auditors at Atlas Bank are running a CAIQ review focused on multi-tenant runtime isolation and data segmentation in inference platforms. They asked for a compact mapping of CAIQ/CCM controls that relate to tenant isolation (networking, memory/kv cache separation, tenant-aware encryption, runtime scheduling) plus supporting artifacts we can include in our submission.

Specifically, can you provide the following?
- A short control crosswalk (CAIQ question -> CCM control id -> Redwood answer) for the controls called out in the attached audit scope (we're particularly focused on CCM controls DSI-01 / DSI-03 and RTR-02 in our scope).
- Architecture diagram showing runtime tenant boundaries and any per-tenant cryptographic separation.
- A 30-day log sample that demonstrates per-tenant telemetry (anonymized) and the logging retention statement.
- A short attestation from your security team about logical isolation guarantees for the hosted and dedicated runtimes.

If you can deliver a draft by EOD Friday (2027-01-08) that would let us include it in our compliance packet. I'm happy to queue a short call with our audit lead if it's helpful.

Thanks,
Molly Jensen
Sr. InfoSec Manager
Atlas Bank

Attachment referenced in their request: audit-scope-atlasbank.pdf (they emailed separately).
